title: Filing of returns.
bodyText: All monthly, quarterly, semiannual, and annual returns shall be transmitted in the form and manner prescribed by the department.
bodyHtml: §251-7  Filing of returns.  All monthly, quarterly, semiannual, and annual returns shall be transmitted in the form and manner prescribed by the department. [L 1991, c 263, pt of §1; am L 2021, c 117, §30]
